notes.summary: Draft reconstruction of genuine big-class closure, all-point envelopes, normalized compactness and section-volume energy from exactly G0/G1; the full equation is not proved.
notes.detailedSummary: In the full smooth projective, algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero, actual big rational-bundle domain, reconstructs model envelopes from G1 before closure, repairs old-pole comparison by actual relative floors and positive guards, and derives actual all-point closure, envelopes and divisorial compactness using only actual-ample G0. Full section lattices yield raw volume energy and finite atomic model derivatives, then actual E1 and compact cost sublevels. Ordinary algebraic background and primary proof scopes are explicit. No general nonample equation, mixed unbounded operator or comparison is imported; these remain unverified deductions.
notes.text:
Research-draft foundations in the full big rational-bundle domain; no completed equation is asserted.

Retained data are an arbitrary algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field k, a smooth integral projective n-fold X with n>=1, and an actual big rational line bundle L. K=X^an is the original compact carrier, theta=c1(L), and V=vol_X(L)>0. There is no countability, support, toric, skeletal, finite-generation or fixed-model restriction. Norms are the canonical trivial section norms. A generically finite FS function is m^(-1) max_j(log||s_j||+lambda_j), with actual sections of an actual rational bundle. Common zeros may give -infinity. PSH(theta) means actual all-point decreasing single-net limits of these functions with numerical classes tending to theta and finite generic value; it is not an abstract completion.

The only caller grants used are G0, the entire supplied P16.1 body ONLY for actual ample rational bundles with its exact retained foundations, and G1, the supplied relative asymptotic-multiplier-ideal generation theorem and its ONE actual FS net on smooth resolved equivariant models, product away from time zero. G1 allows supported poles, uses complete-system nonempty degrees cofinal in divisibility, and supplies generation in every admissible degree. It supplies no general closure, envelope identity or energy theorem. Ordinary algebraic resolution, Kodaira decomposition, positive products, Fujita, section growth and volume differentiation in characteristic zero are explicitly imported background; the pertinent BFJ statement/proof units and applications are retained. The supplied candidates are mathematical data, not further grants.

Actual ample embeddings preserve scalar section formulas: tensor into an actual ample difference bundle using weight-zero generators. The maximum of their canonical section norms is exactly zero. A defining numerical-class net can therefore be placed, on a tail, in one fixed actual ample bundle; appending its floor -N gives finite ample stages with the same all-point endpoint on the product net. G0 then supplies finite divisorial values, generic supremum, and all-point order determination. Addition, rational scaling and finite maxima follow from literal section products on a product net. Real convex combinations use increasing rational coefficients on functions shifted to be nonpositive, followed by one fixed constant correction.

First reconstruct the model envelope, before any general closure. For an actual big B and rational model obstacle f, G1 gives decreasing stages Psi_m=f+phi_bm/m+phi_C/m in FS(B+C/m), with Q_B(f)<=Psi<=f, where Q is the supremum of actual fixed-B FS minorants. Psi is genuine by its ONE defining net. If tau is any genuine B-psh minorant of f, choose an actual Kodaira identity B=C0+E with C0 ample and E effective. Its defining stages can be represented, without changing scalar values, in B+epsilon_i C0, epsilon_i->0. Compact comparison with the finite continuous f+a puts late stages h_i below f+a. Then chi_i=(h_i+epsilon_i log||s_E||)/(1+epsilon_i) is an actual FS function of B. Since log||s_E||<=0, chi_i-a-epsilon_i||f|| is below f, hence below Q. At every divisorial point the added logarithm is finite; taking limits gives tau<=Q+a<=Psi+a. Let a decrease to zero, then use G0 order determination in a common actual ample bundle to get tau<=Psi at EVERY point. Therefore P_B(f)=Psi. In particular V_B=P_B(0) is genuine, has generic value zero, and dominates every normalized genuine B potential.

The closure repair uses this actual reference bound at old poles. If an old FS stage F satisfies F>=(1-delta)psi-k, with psi<=0 an actual reference stage, and incoming h<=psi+C, then off the poles of F,
    h-F<=delta psi+C+k.
Assign -infinity to this comparison at the poles of F. The displayed bound proves upper semicontinuity there, without subtracting two infinities. For a decreasing family its nonnegative superlevel sets are closed and nested, so compactness makes a strictly negative limiting comparison negative on a whole tail.

For a decreasing genuine theta-family u_i with finite generic limit u, bound a tail above by one constant M. Choose a target actual bundle L+eta A, a nearby reference class B=L+epsilon A with epsilon<eta/4, and one normalized reference stage psi close enough to B. Choose delta so the actual difference L+eta A-(1-delta)class(psi) is ample. Special FS stages satisfy F>=u+kappa and F>=(1-delta)psi-k, with kappa>0. They exist by taking the maximum of a defining majorant h+kappa and this floor, after both are tensored into the target actual bundle.

For finitely many old special stages, choose a new eta below their reference gaps. A new reference stage psi can be chosen below every old V_B, hence below each old psi_l+c_l. Take delta smaller than every old delta_l and then k large enough: the new floor is below every old stage. Choose kappa less than one quarter of every old guard. Apply the compact pole comparison first to u_i+2kappa, and then to the defining net of one fixed late u_i, obtaining h+kappa below every old stage. Their maximum with the new floor is a common lower special stage, still above u+kappa. Eta may be arbitrarily small. At each fixed point choose u_i, its defining h and the guard close to u; lower the floor by k. This gives the exact infimum u, including its -infinity points. Thus the special stages form ONE all-point decreasing FS net, with classes tending to theta. This proves decreasing closure in this big domain, without the false abstract twice-closure lemma.

For an upper-bounded usc obstacle with a genuine minorant, continuous/model majorants have that obstacle as their all-point infimum. Their model envelopes decrease, preserve a finite generic lower bound, and their genuine limit is below the obstacle and dominates every competitor. Hence the envelope is genuine. The usc supremum of a bounded-above genuine family is genuine by applying this envelope statement to that supremum.

Normalized compactness follows inside a common actual ample cone. The needed nonnegligibility at divisorial points is proved by a finite-vertex separator: extract the tested divisorial Gauss valuation on an SNC model; section factorization at the center gives h(x)<=sum_j b_j w(z_j)h(x_j), with nonnegative coefficients summing to one. A model function has the corresponding exact barycentric value. G0 ample regularization passes this inequality to ample psh functions. Compactness of the ample normalized cone bounds the spread at its finite vertex set. Choose a PL separator zero at the tested vertex and greater than twice this spread at every other vertex. Then sup(h-q)=(h-q)(z) for every normalized ample potential. The usc supremum of a bounded family consequently does not change its value at z. Regularized tail suprema of a divisorially convergent theta-net are genuine theta-functions and decrease to the prescribed coordinate limit. The closure just proved and G0 all-point determination make the theta cone closed in the compact ample cone. This argument uses nets, not countable extraction.

The section-volume energy is also reconstructed. On a smooth equivariant model with F=sum b_E E and vertical D, the full relative lattice has an adapted basis t^(-w_mj) k[t]s_mj, with weights linearly bounded in m. For sufficiently large c the actual absolute complete sections are t^(-(w_mj+mc)+r)s_mj, 0<=r<=w_mj+mc. Hence h0=sum_j(w_mj+mc+1) and
    vol(rho_X^*L+D+cF)=(n+1)cV+(n+1)mathscrE(f_D).
Volume-root concavity at large c gives concavity of this intercept; lattice inclusions give monotonicity and V-Lipschitz control. A central prime derivative gives a nonnegative coefficient q_E=<alpha^n>.E, independent of sufficiently large c. Its genuine finite-model measure is sum_E b_E q_E delta_{x_E}, of raw mass V. All b_E remain present.

For an original continuous f use the entire original section filtration W_m(f;s)=inf_K(mf-log||s||). Norm comparison and section growth extend mathscrE uniquely to C(K). The section inequality W_m(f;s)>=lambda is equivalent to m^(-1)(log||s||+lambda)<=P_theta(f), so energy depends only on the genuine envelope. Define
    E(u)=inf_{f continuous, f>=u}mathscrE(f),
    E1(theta)={actual u in PSH(theta): E(u)>-infinity}.
The reference is V_theta=P_theta(0), with E(V_theta)=0 and E(u+c)=E(u)+cV. Compact comparison proves decreasing energy continuity, including -infinity. Relative floors max(u,V_theta-N) recover this energy. Concave finite-atomic supporting planes give E(u)=inf_D[mathscrE(f_D)+integral(u-f_D)dmu_D]; their fixed finite divisorial coordinates make E weakly upper semicontinuous. Thus normalized finite-cost sublevels are compact sets of actual functions. A mixed nonnef operator, comparison or arbitrary-target equation does not follow from these foundations.

notes.summary: Draft reconstruction of complete moving-system cofinality, actual horizontal-factor removal, fixed-obstacle missing-rank trace, quadratic contraction and intrinsic dual/coercivity; attainment remains unproved.
notes.detailedSummary: Uses n1 foundations. Proves positive-product cofinality for every power and each fixed signed Cartier test via actual ample competitors with effective remainders. Removes the actual generic full-system fixed factor before resolving a genuinely vertical residual ideal. Retains (min f)(V-A_m^n) until the moving-degree limit and retains the generic linear contraction error until zero. Obtains B((1-r)V_theta+ru)<=2^(n+1)r^2 B(u) on all actual E1; relative target integrability is equivalent to finite intrinsic dual energy, and its objective is coercive. This does not prove fixed-target integral continuity or variational attainment. The 1890-case rational coefficient grid is finite evidence only.
notes.text:
Research-draft moving-system trace, contraction and intrinsic target results in the entire domain of n1. This note uses n1's genuine closure, envelope, compactness and section-volume energy constructions. It supplies neither an arbitrary-target solution nor comparison.

For a smooth projective d-fold Z and actual big rational N, resolve the FULL base ideal of |mN| and write p_m^*(mN)=M_m+G_m, with M_m globally generated and G_m effective. Set A_m=M_m/m. Use nonempty admissible degrees cofinal in divisibility; graded multiplication gives A_ml>=A_m in effective divisor order on a common domination. No finite generation is needed.

Every positive power converges to the corresponding ordinary algebraic positive product. To verify cofinality, take any finite rational nef competitors beta_i<=N with psef remainders on one determination. Choose an actual ample Q0 with N-Q0 big. The actual representatives Qi=(1-epsilon)beta_i+epsilon Q0 are ample and N-Qi big. In one large common degree q, qQi is generated and q(N-Qi) has an effective section divisor Ri. Multiplication injects each generated system into the actual full system |qN|, using proper birational normality for its sections. Hence Gq<=Ri and Aq>=Qi. Nef intersection monotonicity gives Aq^p>=Q1...Qp. Let epsilon decrease on that fixed determination. This proves the least upper bound is <N^p>, for every 1<=p<=d. BFJ's directed compactness converts it to weak convergence. A fixed signed Cartier test H is handled by writing H=H1-H2 with two fixed ample classes and pairing separately; no effective-order inequality is applied to a signed H. The test is fixed before the degree limit.

For a normalized nonpositive original model obstacle f_D, choose one sufficiently large time twist c. Its FULL absolute basis is t^(-(w_mj+mc)+r)s_mj, 0<=r<=w_mj+mc. Resolve |mL| on X_m and write the actual identity p_m^*L=A_m+T_m, mA_m generated, mT_m effective. On a common total model remove the factor s_{mT_m} from EVERY absolute section before resolving the residual ideal. The endpoint r=w_mj+mc at infinity and the full basis at every other nonzero time recover the entire system |mA_m|. Therefore the residual ideal is the unit ideal away from zero, and its resolved divisor G_m^vert is actually vertical, effective. The actual moving total bundle is
    C_m=rho_X^*A_m+D+cF-G_m^vert/m,
globally generated and nef. Its bounded relative potential psi_m belongs to the actual generic nef bundle A_m. The pulled section identities are phi_m,D=q_Tm+psi_m and phi_m,0=q_Tm. They are not arbitrary lifts of an original finite-energy potential. In particular no original E1 status is assigned to the polar physical complete-system FS function.

The preceding full-system cofinality gives V_m=A_m^n->V, C_m^(n+1)->vol(alpha_D(c)), and every fixed signed lower-product pairing. The bounded auxiliary nef energy satisfies
    e_m(psi_m)=C_m^(n+1)/(n+1)-cV_m -> E(P_theta(f_D)).
This energy and its mixed products are genuine fixed-model intersections, obtained from G0 actual ample perturbations and a finite polynomial limit. Their positive component coefficients keep every central multiplicity b_E. No general unbounded nef or nonample equation is used. The generic value g_m of psi_m tends to zero, by powers of actual section minorants approximating the envelope's generic value. Although psi_m<=0, g_m need not equal zero at finite m.

The trace inequality has an essential missing-rank term. Fix m and an ORIGINAL continuous obstacle f dominating q_Tm+psi after pullback, with psi a bounded nonpositive auxiliary nef model potential. In admissible degree ell, multiplication by s_{ell T_m} injects H0(X_m,ell A_m) into H0(X,ell L). Analytic surjectivity and the actual section identity make each induced original weight at least its auxiliary weight. Every remaining original weight is at least ell min_K f, since canonical norms are at most one. Extending an adapted filtration basis proves
    Tr_original >= Tr_auxiliary +(r_ell-d_ell) ell min_K f
up to rounding error bounded by the ranks. First let ell tend to infinity, with m and f fixed. The bounded nef trace equals its actual intersection energy, by the same full lattice computation after a nef time twist. Thus
    mathscrE(f)>=e_m(psi)+(min_K f)(V-V_m).
The last term is generally negative. It may be removed ONLY when the moving degree m subsequently tends to infinity with the finite continuous obstacle f fixed. Relative-to-reference control or a probability rank substitution would lose this term.

The contraction is obtained from a finite polynomial with its generic error retained. For psi<=0 on A_m, put a_k=integral(-psi)(A_m+ddc psi)^k A_m^(n-k), k=0,...,n. These are nonnegative, all mixed masses are V_m, a0=-psi(v0)V_m, and B_m(psi)=(sum a_k)/(n+1). For 0<=r<=1,
    B_m(r psi)=r/(n+1) sum_{j=0}^n sum_{k=0}^j binom(j,k) r^k(1-r)^(j-k)a_k
                <=r a0+2^(n+1) r^2 B_m(psi).
The k=0 terms contribute at most r a0; every other term contains an extra r and its binomial sum is bounded by 2^(n+1). This proves the inequality in every dimension.

Let u=P_theta(f_D) be normalized and u^r=(1-r)V_theta+ru. The actual physical section combination q_Tm+r psi_m lies below u^r. For EACH fixed continuous majorant f of u^r apply the trace inequality and the preceding polynomial. Keep both signed errors: r(-g_m V_m) and (min f)(V-V_m). Let m tend through the full divisibility subnet; only then take the infimum over f. This proves
    B((1-r)V_theta+ru)<=C_n r^2 B(u), C_n=2^(n+1).
For arbitrary normalized genuine E1 u, normalized nonpositive model-envelope majorants decrease all-point to u and in energy. Passing that genuine decreasing limit gives the same inequality on the ENTIRE actual E1 cone. Rational r suffices for sections; finite segment concavity gives all real r in [0,1].

The intrinsic relative target convention is explicit. A positive original Radon nu has raw mass V and must annihilate Z_theta={V_theta=-infinity}. Off Z_theta define I_nu(u)=integral(V_theta-u)dnu for normalized u, and
    D_nu=sup_{normalized actual u in E1}[I_nu(u)-B(u)].
No absolute integrability of V_theta is silently assumed. In this convention D_nu is finite if and only if EVERY genuine relative E1 test is integrable. One implication follows directly from the supremum. For the converse, if integrals were unbounded on B<=1, select u_j with integral gap>=4^j and form decreasing actual convex sums v_N=sum_{j<=N}2^-j u_j+2^-N V_theta. Concavity gives cost<=1; n1's genuine closure and energy continuity give an actual finite-energy limit. Its relative gap is the increasing sum of the gaps, whose integral is infinite, a contradiction. Write C_nu for the resulting unit-cost bound. Contract a general u with r=(C_n B(u))^(-1/2) when C_n B>=1. Then I_nu(u)<=C_nu sqrt(C_n B(u)); small costs have the direct unit-cost bound. This makes sup(I-B) finite.

For a finite-dual target, contraction gives r I_nu(u)<=C_n r^2 B(u)+D_nu. Choose r=epsilon/C_n, 0<epsilon<=C_n, to obtain
    I_nu(u)<=epsilon B(u)+C_n D_nu/epsilon.
Thus the variational objective is coercive on normalized actual functions. A maximizing sequence has bounded cost and therefore an actual weak cluster by n1. This does NOT prove attainment: continuity of its unbounded fixed-target integrals and absence of an energy/integral jump remain unproved here.

notes.summary: Draft target-independent outer-energy measure on original X^an, raw volume, both absolute continuous derivative signs and algebraic/reference pole nullness; genuine full weighted identification remains open.
notes.detailedSummary: Uses n1. Deficient fixed-time big-volume measures have coefficientwise positive tails and deficit at most B/c. A uniform big margin on a fixed test determination yields a Taylor bound, with c fixed before either sign of t tends to zero and c then infinite. Actual model-envelope majorants construct a unique original-carrier mass-vol(L) measure without targets; absolute original C0 tests and decreasing E1 weak continuity are retained. It agrees with finite model derivative measures and annihilates algebraic section-zero/reference-pole sets. This is not a claimed completed genuine Monge-Ampere extension: entire output integrability, nonalgebraic/negligible nullness, all-E1 weighted limits, comparison and the equation are unproved.
notes.text:
Research-draft construction of a target-independent original-carrier outer-energy measure, using n1's actual PSH, envelopes and section-volume energy. This is a partial operator construction; full genuine unbounded weighted Monge-Ampere identification, output integrability, comparison and the inverse equation remain unproved.

Retain the entire positive-volume domain of n1, its intrinsic minimal reference V_theta and raw mass V=vol(L). For a normalized nonpositive model obstacle f_D with mathscrE(f_D)>=-B define g_D(c)=vol(rho_X^*L+D+cF)/(n+1). The full lattice formula gives
    g_D(c)=lim_m n!/m^(n+1) sum_j(w_mj+mc)_+.
Hence g is convex, V-Lipschitz, g(0)=0, g(c)>=cV-B, and eventually g(c)=cV+mathscrE(f_D). For c>B/V its algebraic class is big. Volume differentiation gives the positive finite model measure
    mu_D,c=sum_E b_E <alpha_D(c)^n>.E delta_xE,
of mass g_D'(c) between V-B/c and V. Effective-prime volume monotonicity makes each coefficient nonnegative.

The deficit is coefficientwise. The actual trace tail
    T_D(c)=mathscrE(f_D)+cV-g_D(c)
          =lim_m n!/m^(n+1) sum_j min(w_mj+mc,0)
increases when an effective vertical prime is added to D, because inclusion orders the actual full section flags. Differentiate in that prime, using both the eventual energy derivative and the fixed-c big volume derivative. This proves 0<=mu_D,c<=mu_D and total-variation deficit <=B/c. A positive curve-class order is never paired directly with a nonnef central prime.

Fix an original model test h represented by signed H on a smooth determination Z. Choose an ample T on Z; its pullback to refinements is nef. With gamma=rho_X^*L+cF, alpha_D(c)<=gamma and vol(alpha_D(c))>=(n+1)(cV-B)=kappa. While alpha-rT is big, differentiability and positive-product order bound its volume-loss derivative by M=(n+1)<gamma^n>.T. Boundary volume continuity proves alpha-r0 T big for r0=kappa/[2(M+1)], uniformly over allowed obstacles and refinements. Otherwise the first exit would have positive volume. If aT+/-H are nef, lambda=a/r0 gives lambda alpha+/-H pseudoeffective. Therefore for small |t|lambda the positive products of alpha+tH lie between (1+/-lambda|t|)^n<alpha^n>. Pair separately with two fixed nef classes representing H, bounded above by their gamma products. Integrating yields a finite uniform K_c and a Taylor error K_c t^2/2 for the deficient energy derivative.

For either sign of t, correct D+tH by subtracting |t| ||h|| F. Its obstacle is nonpositive and has cost at most B'=B+2V||h|| for |t|<=1. The corresponding deficient parameter c+|t|||h|| restores the same actual absolute class. The coefficientwise tail bound along this path and the Taylor estimate imply
    |mathscrE(f_D+th)-mathscrE(f_D)-t integral h dmu_D|
       <=K_c t^2/2+|t|||h||(B+B')/c.
Its limit order is essential: FIX c, let either sign of t tend to zero, THEN let c tend to infinity. The small allowed t interval may depend on c.

For normalized actual u in E1, direct all nonpositive model majorants f_i down to u. Their envelopes and energies decrease to u and E(u), and their measures have positive raw mass V. A weak cluster measure exists on the original compact K. For each fixed model h and t, P_theta(f_i+th) decreases genuinely to P_theta(u+th), which lies between u+/-|t|||h|| and is finite energy. Passing the uniform estimate through these energy limits and the cluster, then using both signs and the stated limit order, identifies its integrals with
    derivative at 0 of E(P_theta(u+th)).
All clusters have the same model integrals. Uniform model density and raw mass V imply uniqueness, so the whole net converges. This defines M(u), a positive Radon measure on ORIGINAL X^an before any target is chosen. It is constant invariant and has mass V. For every original continuous h, uniform model approximation changes the divided energy increment and measure integral by at most V||h-h_j||. Fix j before t->0 and then let j->infinity. Thus both ORIGINAL continuous derivative signs hold.

An ordered bounded-cost energy gap controls a fixed model integral by
    |integral h d(M(a)-M(b))|
       <=[E(a)-E(b)]/|t|+K_c|t|+C_h(B)/c, a>=b.
This follows from the two perturbed-envelope estimates and obstacle order. Let the energy gap vanish first, then t->0 at fixed c, then c->infinity. It proves weak measure continuity for decreasing genuine E1 nets with genuine E1 endpoint. Agreement at model envelopes is checked using min(f_D,f_i): these obstacles have the same envelope energy as f_D, so the ordered zero-gap estimate identifies their measures with the original finite atomic mu_D before their decreasing endpoint. This is not a measure defined by solving an inverse target problem.

There is a LIMITED polar conclusion. For a fixed effective section divisor S, its pullback splits into effective horizontal part and vertical coefficients b_E x_E(s). Effective-horizontal volume monotonicity and a fixed nef majorant give integral v(s)dmu_D,c<=C_c uniformly over cost-B obstacles. The original capped b_N=min(v(s),N) is continuous, including value N on the algebraic zero locus. The full measure tail gives integral b_N dmu_D<=C_c+NB/c. Pass to M(u), divide by N, let N->infinity, then c->infinity. Thus every fixed proper algebraic section-zero locus has zero M(u) mass. An actual Kodaira reference bound V_theta>=log||s_E|| places its pole set inside such a locus, so M(u) annihilates the reference pole set.

This does not establish integrability of V_theta-u against M(u), integrability of every relative E1 test, finite intrinsic dual energy of every output, nonalgebraic polar/negligible nullness, or all-E1 weighted identification. Weak convergence cannot be tested directly by moving unbounded functions. Neither the derivative theorem nor this limited nullness proves strict comparison or actual arbitrary-target variational attainment. Accordingly M is called an outer-energy measure here; calling it a completed genuine full finite-energy Monge-Ampere operator would overstate the proved identification.

notes.text:
Canonical outcome: original P16.5 remains incomplete, candidate=false. The standalone paper and evidence bundle are saved. This note uses n1--n3 for the positive-volume constructions and their limitations, and proves separately the exact additional raw-zero range below.

For every algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero k, smooth integral projective X of dimension n>=1, and ACTUAL numerically trivial rational L (including nontorsion Pic^0), use the numerical varying-actual-bundle PSH convention and the canonical trivial reference. Constants are genuine because actual L+epsilon A is ample and has weight-zero generating systems whose scalar functions are identically zero. For normalized u in PSH(0), integer section powers give mu in PSH(0) for all positive integers m. Place these scalars in one fixed actual ample cone. G0 normalized compactness and finite divisorial coordinates give -C_z<=mu(z)<=0 at each fixed divisorial z, uniformly in m. Hence u(z)=0. G0 all-point order determination in that ample cone gives u=0 everywhere. Thus PSH(0)=R, without requiring sections of a fixed degree of L or nonample decreasing closure.

The target-independent raw zero product on constants is zero: positive actual ample perturbations have mass epsilon^n(A^n)->0, so their integrals of every original continuous test tend to zero. The energy relative to zero is identically zero. Thus actual E1(0)=R, its intrinsic positive raw mass-zero target is only the zero measure, dual energy is zero, and E1(0)/R -> {0} is a bijection. All solutions are constants; comparison and both derivative signs are trivial. There is no probability normalization or division by zero, and the unnormalized zero energy is not a separating distance.

This covers the whole NUMERICALLY TRIVIAL rational-bundle range, not all zero-volume classes. On P1 x P1 with L=p1^*O(1), vol(L)=L^2=0 while the pullback of max(log||z1||,-1) is a nonconstant bounded FS potential. Its bounded nef top measure and that of zero both vanish by positivity and zero intersection mass. Explicit ample-perturbation masses are 2epsilon(1+epsilon)->0. Consequently this raw zero top equation cannot have uniqueness modulo constants on that whole cone.
